## What are you requesting?

Describe the mod, configuration change, compatibility improvement, quality-of-life change, or other request.

## Why would it fit Cornerstone Unbound?

Explain what it would add or improve and why it fits the pack's broad, classic-modded focus.

## Existing overlap or conflicts

If you know of an included mod or feature that already does something similar, mention it here.

## Relevant version or link

If this request concerns a specific mod, include its Minecraft version and an official project link when available.

## Additional context

Add any other details that would help evaluate the request.
